name: What are common upgrades that add value to a condo?

mainEntity.name: What are common upgrades that add value to a condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common upgrades that significantly add value to a condo include kitchen and bathroom renovations, as these are primary selling points. Upgrading to energy-efficient appliances, modern flooring (like engineered wood or luxury vinyl), and smart home technology also appeal to buyers. Improving storage solutions and enhancing lighting can also make a condo feel more spacious and modern. Focus on quality materials and timeless designs for the best return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Value-adding condo upgrades include kitchen/bathroom renovations, energy-efficient appliances, modern flooring, smart home tech, and improved storage and lighting.
